Allow me to introduce myself again, Your Highness.
I am deeply honored to have audience with you, and I am thrilled.
m920105.いえ、こちらこそ正体を隠していて申し訳ありません。\n確実に敵の裏をかくには「敵: No, I'm the one who should apologize for hiding my true identity. To reliably outwit the enemy, we had to practice “to deceive the enemy, start from your own side”....
m920105.いてて……。\nったく、王子、模擬戦で本気出すなよなー。:
Ouch……
Geez, Prince, don't go all out in a mock battle.
m920105.いや～、こっちの戦力が手薄になる時期を見計らって\n生き残りの仙人たちが神仙郷を: Well, I expected the surviving sages would try to retake Shenxian Village when our forces got thin.
m920105.え、どうしてわかるんですか？: Wait, how do you know that?
m920105.ええ……疑ってすみませんでした。\n貴方が行軍中に度々姿を消していたのは、\nナ: Yes… I'm sorry for doubting. The times you vanished during the march were because you were going to summon Nataku and the others.
m920105.ええ……頭では理解できても\n心の中では整理しきれないものというのは、\nやはり: Yes… even if we understand it intellectually, there's still something we can't quite reconcile in our hearts.
m920105.ええ、こう見えて一応仙人ということになっております。\nまぁ、訳あって神仙郷から: …Indeed. Though I may not look the part, I am officially a sage. I was ordered to descend from the Sacred Immortal Village to the mortal world for… reasons.
m920105.ええ。皆さん、頑張ってくださいね。\n神仙郷への道のりは、まだ始まったばかりなの: Yes. Everyone, do your best. The road to the Divine Realm has only just begun.
m920105.お、もう終わりか？\n妙に呆気なく引き上げて行ったな。: Oh, is it over? They pulled back so abruptly.
m920105.おそらくは。\n神仙郷に近づけば、\n敵の警戒が厳重になるのは予想されたことです: Most likely. As we draw nearer to the Divine Immortal Village, it's expected that the enemy's vigilance will tighten.
m920105.が、悪いがこの先の神仙郷に向かおうとする\n身の程知らずたちにキツ～いお灸をすえ: Sorry, but it's my job to give a scorching lesson to those fools trying to head to the Divine Realm. Got it?
m920105.くっ……話を聞いてなかったの？\n華の国の邪仙たちが総力を挙げて攻めてくるのよ？: Damn… you didn't hear? The evil sages of the Flower Nation are launching a full-scale attack. This isn't the time to be squabbling internally!
m920105.くっ……鬼門に逃げ込まれたか。: Damn… They've fled into the demon gate.
m920105.ぐあッ……や、やるじゃあないかキミたち……！: Gah… you're putting up a good fight, you lot…!
m920105.ここが神仙郷……。\n確かに清らかな気の流れを感じますね。:
This is the Sage Village…
I can truly feel the pure flow of ki.
m920105.このたび、邪仙たちに占領されている\n我らが神仙郷を奪還する目処が立ちましたので: This time, with the evil immortals occupying our Sacred Immortal Village, we finally have a chance to reclaim it, so I've come to humbly request your assistance.
m920105.このように足場の悪い山道は、\n邪仙の主力たる道士たちが得意とする浮遊術によって: This rugged mountain path, with its poor footing, is perfect terrain—its uneven ground lets the enemy sorcerers, who rely on levitation, seize the high ground.
m920105.このワシが風神と同じ末路を辿るというのか？\n馬鹿馬鹿しい、侮るのもいい加減にし: You're saying I'll meet the same fate as the Wind God? Ridiculous. Stop underestimating me already!
m920105.この程度の罠など、ほんの手遊びのようなもの。\n今後はさらに気を引き締めて参りま: This kind of trap is merely child's play. We'll need to stay even sharper from now on.
m920105.これ以上ここで兵を失っては\n神仙郷の防衛に支障をきたしかねん……。\nよってこ: If we lose any more troops here, it'll jeopardize the defense of the Divine Realm… So… tactical retreat!
m920105.さぁ、拝見させていただきましょう。\n英雄との呼び声高い王子殿下の実力を。: Very well, let me take a look… to assess the might of His Highness, the Prince, whose name is sung by heroes.
m920105.さぁ、攻めてくるがいい。\n神仙郷をワシらの手から解放したいのだろう？:
Come on, attack us.
You want to free the Sage Village from our grasp, don't you?
m920105.さて、それでは\n急に襲ってきた理由を説明していただきましょうか？: Now then, shall we have an explanation for why you attacked us so suddenly?
m920105.しかし、今回は東の国侵攻に戦力が割かれていた上、\n包囲作戦を実行するために戦力: But this time our troops were tied up invading the eastern lands, and to execute the encirclement we had to disperse forces, leaving the main army thin.
m920105.じ……十天君の一人ですって？: Y-You say you're one of the Ten Heavenly Sages?
m920105.すみません……気を抜く余裕がありませんでしたので。: I'm sorry……I didn't have the luxury to let my guard down.
m920105.せめて策を授けたヤツがここにいれば……。\nいや、いまさら嘆いても仕方あるまい。: If only the one who gave me the plan were here… No point lamenting now. —All units, retreat! Don't waste any more lives!
m920105.そう、まずは目の前の敵を倒すことに集中するのです。: That's right—first, focus on taking down the enemies right in front of us.
m920105.そうだ。それにぬしは風神と共に\n妖怪総大将、シノの血判状に名を記したはず。: That's right. Besides, you pledged your name to the Blood Seal of Shino, the Grand General of the youkai, together with the Wind God.
m920105.そうだそうだ！\nオレだって一緒に修行するって\n太公望と約束したんだからなー！:
That's right, that's right!
I promised Taigong Wang I'd train together, so don't take her!
m920105.そのためにも、引き続き邪仙たちの脅威を\nできるだけ多くの同胞たちに伝えて\n協: And to that end, we should keep spreading the threat of the evil sages to as many of our comrades as possible, urging them to join us.
m920105.その妖天君が何処からか現れ、術で妖どもを操って\n次々と軍列に加えているのを見た: Someone saw Yotenkun appear out of nowhere, using his magic to command monsters and add them to his ranks one after another.
m920105.その過程で再び道が交わることもあるでしょう。\nその時になりましたら、またお会い: Our paths may cross again in the process. When that happens, let's meet once more.
m920105.それができなかった私に、\nいまさら神仙郷の仙人を名乗る資格があると思う？: Since I couldn't do that, do I still have any right to call myself an immortal of Shenxian Village now?
m920105.それがどうした？\n無闇に手出しをせぬとは誓ったが、\n貴様ら人間と馴れ合うつも: So what? I swore I wouldn't intervene recklessly, but I have no intention of cozying up to you humans at all.
m920105.それと、飛行する道士の術は有効射程が短いようです。\n痛手を被らずに倒したければ: Also, the flying Taoist's technique has a short effective range. If you want to defeat them without taking heavy damage, aim from afar with bows or other ranged weapons.
m920105.それに、すごく毛並みのいい\n馬みたいな動物を背もたれにしていますね……。\nう:
And they're using a horse-like creature with such a fine coat as a backrest…
I'm jealous… it's outrageous!
m920105.それに伴い、神仙郷の守護を任じられていた\n邪仙や道士の一部までもが召集されたよ: Along with that, even some of the Evil Immortals and Taoists who were tasked with guarding Shinsen-kyō have been summoned.
m920105.それに加えて、先ほどの罠……。\nまさかとは思いますが、\n敵に通じている可能性: And that trap… I know it's a stretch, but we can't rule out the possibility that she's in league with the enemy.
m920105.それはさておき、\n問題は神仙郷が邪仙たちの手に落ちて以来、\n現在も彼らの支配: Anyway, the problem is that since Shinsen-kyō fell into the hands of the Evil Immortals, it remains under their control…
m920105.それはさておき、王子。\n此度のご協力、誠にありがとうございました。\nおかげさ: That aside, Prince, thank you sincerely for your help this time. Thanks to you, we were able to retake Shenxian Village safely.
m920105.それほど敵も余裕が無いということでしょう。: It seems the enemy is stretched thin.
m920105.それより、神仙郷まではあと少しです。\n皆さん、張り切って参りましょう！: Anyway, we're almost at the Divine Realm. Let's give it our all!
m920105.そんなに死に急ぐなら、\n望み通りにしてあげるヨ……ほほいっ！: If you're so eager to die, I'll grant your wish… Hehe!
m920105.だからこそ、東の国への遠征に集中させていた\n戦力の一部を引き上げて罠を張ってい: That's why we pulled back some troops from the eastern expedition and set a trap—
m920105.だが、いくらうるさく飛び回ろうが\nこの雷神は貴様ら人間の指図は受けぬ！: Still, no matter how loudly you flit about, this Thunder God won't take orders from you humans!
m920105.ちょっと待ってよ。\n太公望はこれからの神仙郷に必要な女性だ。\n勝手に連れて行:
Hold on a second.
Taigong Wang is a woman we'll need in the Divine Realm.
If you try to whisk her away, I won't allow it.
m920105.って、アンナさんまで！\nうぅ……全部聞いていらっしゃったのですね？: Wait, even you, Anna! …Ugh… you heard everything, didn't you?
m920105.ですが、くれぐれもご注意ください。\n道士たちは術で崖を上って近道してくるかもし: But be careful. The sorcerers might use their techniques to climb the cliffs and take a shortcut. They won't necessarily follow the road.
m920105.と……とにかく、\n雷神の魂パクを奪われるわけにはいきません！\nここは私たちで: A-and anyway, we can't let Raijin have his soul taken! Let's take him down ourselves!
m920105.ということは……まさか！\n太公望、キミはこちらの作戦を読んだ上で\nあらかじめ: So… you mean! Taigong Wang, you read our plan and called in reinforcements beforehand?
m920105.とにかく、仙人様をお探ししましょう。\n仙人様ー、いらっしゃいますかー？: Anyway, let's find the Sage. Sage—are you there?
m920105.とはいえ、妖どもと我らの間の溝は\nそう簡単に埋まるものではござらん。: Nevertheless, the gap between us and the youkai isn't something that can be bridged so easily.
m920105.ともあれ、魔物出現の報告を上げて\n私たちをここに呼び寄せたのは貴方ですね？: In any case, you're the one who reported the monster sighting and summoned us here, right?
m920105.とんだご無礼をつかまつりました！\nどうか……どうかご容赦くださいませっ！: …I've committed a most egregious rudeness! Please… please forgive me!
m920105.と申しますのも、\n先ほど王子たちが敵と交戦していた間、\n彼女は霊獣に乗ってど: While you were engaged with the enemy earlier, she rode a spirit beast and disappeared somewhere…
m920105.どうかなさいましたか？\nなんだか上の空といったご様子ですが。: Is something wrong? You seem a bit distracted.
m920105.な……なぜだッ！？\nなぜ背後にいた兵が彼らを攻撃しない！？: Wh… why?! Why aren't the troops behind us attacking them?!
m920105.な、なんですかあの人は？\nこんなところで呑気に魚釣りなんかして。:
W-what's that person doing?
Fishing so leisurely here…
m920105.なにを言う。\nお主の盟友、風神が妖天君という邪仙に魂パクを奪われ、\nそやつの: What are you saying? Have you forgotten that your ally, the Wind God, had his soul stolen by the evil sage Yotenkun and was turned into a puppet?
m920105.なるほどな。敵は俺たちを油断させて\nここに誘導して叩こうって魂胆だったわけか。: I see. They tried to lull us into a false sense of security, lure us here, and then strike.
m920105.なッ――王子、大変です！\n部隊が橋の前後で二つに分断されてしまいました！: N—! Prince, we're in trouble! Our forces have been split on both sides of the bridge!
m920105.にしても、見損なったぞ妖天君。\n東の国を侵略するために戦力拡充が必要とはいえ、:
Still, you missed the mark, Yotenkun.
Even though you need to bolster forces to invade the Eastern lands,
to snatch the yokai souls without a second thought…
m920105.ぬぅ……そこまで読んだうえで\nこちらの作戦の裏をかいてくるとは……。: Huh… to anticipate our moves to this extent…
m920105.は、はあ……。\n（なんだかさっきまでと雰囲気が違いますね……）: H-huh… (The atmosphere feels different from a moment ago…)
m920105.は、はい。失礼しました。\n……王子、ひとまず今は戦いに集中しましょう！: Yes, ma'am. Sorry. …Prince, let's focus on the battle for now!
m920105.はぁ……はぁ……や、やったか？: Haa… haa… Did… did we do it?
m920105.はぁ、そういうものなんですね。: Ah, so that's how it works.
m920105.はい……故あって貴軍の実力を\n試させていただきたかったのです。: …Yes… I have my reasons for wanting to test your forces.
m920105.ふふ、そこまで熱心に聞かれては仕方ありませんね。\n実は……ちょっとお花を摘みに: Heh, since you're so eager… Actually… I just went out to pick some flowers.
m920105.ふわぁ……暇ね。\n美味しい桃が食べたいわぁ。:
Sigh… I'm bored.
I could really go for a tasty peach.
m920105.へぇ、こんなところにも街があるのね。\nねえ仙人さん、あとどのくらいで神仙郷に着: Wow, there's a town even out here. Hey Sage, how much longer until we reach the Divine Immortal Village?
m920105.へぇ、まだ喋る元気があるとはネェ。\n丈夫な操り人形が手に入って嬉しいヨ……ほほ: Huh, you still have the energy to talk. Glad I got a sturdy puppet… Hehe!
m920105.へ？ おう――えぇえっ！？\nお、王子！？ なぜ私の後ろに？: Huh? Oh—what!? Prince!? Why are you behind me?
m920105.ほう、あくまで戦うってかい？\nいいね……その心意気、気に入った！\nならば！: Hmm, you still want to fight, huh? Nice… I like that spirit! Then! This time I'll give it my all and show my respect!
m920105.ほう、貴様らはいつぞやの王子らか。\nどんなヤツが来るかと思い、楽しみにしていた:
Huh, you are the prince from back then.
I've been looking forward to seeing what kind of guy would show up.
m920105.ま、まずいよ王子！\n敵がどんどん包囲網を狭めてきてるよぅっ！:
Damn, this is bad, Prince!
The enemy's net is closing in fast!
m920105.ま、待ってください。\nなんだか少し怪しいと思いませんか？: W-wait. Doesn't this feel a bit… suspicious?
m920105.まさか行方知れずだった太公望が\nオレたちの宿敵である王子たちを連れて\n罠にか: Never thought the missing Taigong Wang would bring the princes—our arch-enemies—right into our snare.
m920105.むッ――気をつけろ！\nヤツに操られた妖どもが鬼門から出てくるぞ！: Damn—watch out! The monsters he's controlling are pouring out of the Demon Gate!
m920105.もう間もなくこの国は\nヤツらの侵攻を受けて戦場になるわ。\nそうなった時に備え: Soon this country will become a battlefield under their assault. Prepare now for when that happens.
m920105.やぁ王子、いいところに来てくれたね。\nちょうど今、落ち込んでる太公望を\n神仙: Hey Prince, perfect timing. We were just about to rally the villagers to cheer up a down-in-the-dumps Taigong Wang.
m920105.よっしゃー！ オレは太公望に加勢するぜ！\n神仙郷での修行の成果、見せてやるよっ:
Alright! I'll back up Taigong Wang!
I'll show you the results of my training in the Divine Realm!
m920105.わ、わらわも邪仙郷での暮らしで染み付いた邪気を\n祓う修行法を教わっている最中な:
I… I'm also learning a purification method to cleanse the lingering evil from living in the Evil Immortal Village.
So please… don't take Taigong Wang away.
m920105.わわッ！？ 馬が飛びました！\n翼もないのに、すごいです！:
Whoa! The horse just flew!
It has no wings, but it's amazing!
m920105.オレは迅天君。\n華の国の仙人、十天君が一人の迅天君さ。: I'm Jinten. I'm one of the Ten Heavenly Sages of the Flower Nation.
m920105.ククッ……おめでたい奴らだネェ。\n勝ち負けの他に必要なものが\n戦にあると思っ: Kukuk… Congratulations, you fools. Do you really think there's anything beyond winning and losing in this war?
m920105.グフフ……グハハッ、グハハハハッ！\nこのわしが人間ごときの指図を受けると思うた: Guff… Gahaha! Gahahahaha! Did you really think I'd take orders from mere humans?!
m920105.シズカ様、本当に雷神の根城に向かわれるのですか？: Lady Shizuka, are we really heading to the Thunder God's stronghold?
m920105.ゼェッ、ゼェッ……。\nクソ……適当なこと言いやがって。\n自分は霊獣とかいうの: Huh, huh… Damn… you talk nonsense. You ride some spirit beast and take it easy while the rest of us slog.
m920105.ヌハハッ！ どうした、臆したか？\nならばこちらから行かせてもらうぞ！:
Nuhaha! What's the matter, getting scared?
Then I'll take the initiative!
m920105.ヌフフ……馬鹿め。\nここでのワシの敗北もヤツの計画のうちよ。:
Nufufu… you fool.
My defeat here is part of his plan, after all.
m920105.ハハッ！\n誰だと聞かれちゃあ答えないわけにはいかないねぇ。: ???: Haha! Since you asked, I can't just stay silent.
m920105.ハハッ！ \nかの高名な太公望ともあろう御方が、\n万策尽きたって様子じゃあない: Ha ha! Even the famed Taigong Wang looks like he's out of tricks, doesn't he?
m920105.ハハハッ！ そりゃあそうさ！\nなぜならオレは十天君最速の男！\n常人ではオレを: Hahaha! Of course! I'm the fastest of the Ten Heavenly Sages! Ordinary folks can't even perceive me!
m920105.ハハハッ！ 血迷ったのかい太公望？\nそんなことをすれば、後方に控える我が軍の部: Ha ha! Got blood in your eyes, Taigong Wang? If you do that, my troops waiting in the rear will close the distance and strike you from behind in an instant.
m920105.ヒューッ、震える姿も可愛いねぇ。\nこれから殺すのが惜しいくらいだ。: Hoo, even your trembling looks cute. It's almost a shame to kill you now.
m920105.フッ、戦術的撤退と言ったろ？\n勝利に気を良くしたキミらをおびき寄せて、\nここ:
Heh, I called it a tactical retreat, didn't I?
I lured you, smug about your victory, into this trap and surrounded you.
m920105.フン……人間風情が何の用だ？\nこの雷神様の縄張りを踏み荒らしよって。: Hmph… what do you mortals want? Trespassing on the Thunder God's domain?
m920105.フン……誰が兄貴だ。\nとにかく、包囲完成までの時間は稼いでやったぞ。\nあとは:
Hm… who calls me brother?
Anyway, I bought us some time before the encirclement was complete.
Now just see it through.
m920105.ワシが邪仙如きの手に落ちるだと？\nフン、馬鹿も休み休み言え。: You think I'd fall into the hands of those wretched sages? Hah, even a fool can take a break from talking nonsense.
m920105.万が一の事態に備えて、今後は仙人様の動向に\n細心の注意を払うべきと進言いたしま: To prepare for any eventuality, I recommend we keep a very close eye on the Sage's movements from now on.
m920105.不測の事態に即応する能力があるか否かが、\n貴軍に助力を請うべきか迷っていた\n: I needed to see whether you can respond swiftly to unforeseen situations, as that determines whether we should ask for your aid in the operation to retake the Sacred Immortal Village.
m920105.人間ごときが図に乗りおって……不愉快だ。\n貴様らの立場を思い知らせてくれる！: Humans getting cocky… it's disgusting. I'll make you remember your place!
m920105.今後も続く邪仙たちとの戦いの中で、\n貴方の叡智が必要となる時が来ると思います。:
In the battles ahead against the evil immortals,
there will come a time when we'll need your wisdom.
When that happens, could we count on your cooperation?
m920105.仙人様、この場合はどうすれば――: Sage, what should we do in this situation—
m920105.仙人様、本当にこの道の先に神仙郷があるんですか？: Sage, are you sure the Sacred Immortal Village lies beyond this road?
m920105.仙人様の仰った通りになりましたね。\n王子、迎え撃ちましょう。: Just as the Sage said. Prince, let's meet them head-on.
m920105.勘違いしないで。\n私たちはただ警告に来ただけよ。: Don't get the wrong idea. We're just here to warn you.
m920105.勿論です。\n仙境とは俗界を離れた静かで清浄な地、即ち常人では\nおよそ辿り着け: Of course. A “sacred realm” is a quiet, pure place far removed from the mortal world—a hidden land that ordinary people can scarcely reach.
m920105.卑怯とでも外道とでも、なんとでも言うがいいサ。\n喋れなくなる前に、ネ……。:
Call me coward or heretic, say whatever you like.
Before you lose your voice, you…
m920105.即ち、敵の防備が手薄となった今こそ\n神仙郷を奪還するためのまたとない好機なので: Thus, now that the enemy's defenses are thin, it's a perfect opportunity to retake Shinsen-kyō.

m920201.今悩む必要はないでしょう。\nあなたの神は、この奥に待っているのですから。:
There's no need to worry about it now.
Your god is waiting for you deeper inside.
m920201.何か、隠しているな。\nそしてそれを守るため、ここで神殿内の戦力と合流し、\nこ:
They're hiding something.
And to protect it, they've chosen to join forces with the troops inside the temple and crush us completely.
m920201.何が兵ひとりにゃ。\n神に弓引く英雄王が軍勢、その参謀が\n堂々と領土を闊歩する:
What do you mean, "a single soldier"?
We wouldn't miss the sight of the Hero King, who drew his bow at a god,
and his strategist strutting around our territory so boldly.
m920201.偽りの太陽神と一緒になって、\n随分と天界を荒らしてくれたものだ。\nしかし、そ:
You have caused quite a stir in the heavens,
allied with that false Sun God.
But your wicked deeds end here.
m920201.儂とていつ復活するかなどわからぬからな。\nで、元始天尊、こやつらが英雄王の――:
I have no idea when I'll revive, you know.
Now then, Yuanshi Tianzun, are these the Hero King's――son? Or grandson?
m920201.儂をお婆ちゃん扱いするでない！\nいたわり過ぎも傷つくぞ！: Don't treat me like an old woman! Being coddled hurts my pride, too!
m920201.先導はまかせて！\nうおー！ こっちこっちー！:
Leave the vanguard to me!
Whoa! This way, this way!
m920201.兵の練度はこちらが上、か。\n戦争の経験はあまりないようですね。:
Their troops are outmatched in training, it seems.
They don't appear to have much experience in war.
m920201.創造神の庭、オリュンポスは亜神ディアスの手に落ちた。\n逆らえばアスガルドと同じ: The Garden of the Creator, Olympus, has fallen into the hands of the lesser god Zeus. If we resist, we face the same fate as Asgard. Without a supreme god to lead us, we had no choice but to submit, nya.
m920201.千年戦争の後……乱世の時代の伝承ですね。\n百日に渡る暗黒の時、太陽は失われ、\:
That is a legend from the age of chaos, after the Millennium War.
I have heard that for a hundred days, the sun was lost,
the land withered, and the people starved and died.
m920201.千年戦争の折、物質界にはいくつかの、\n神々の贈り物が残されました。:
During the Millennium War, several
gifts from the gods were left behind in the Material World.
m920201.各都市に伝令を走らせるにゃ！\n我らが世界「ヌン」に侵入者あり！\n潜伏地点を見:
Send messengers to every city!
Intruders have entered our world, "Nun"!
Anyone who spots their hiding place must report it immediately!
m920201.同じ道を歩めるのなら、協力すべき。\n――と、王子が言って譲らなかったので。:
If we can walk the same path, we should cooperate.
That was the Prince's stance, and he refused to budge.
m920201.和平を結ぶと決めたのなら、\n強引にでもそれを推し進めるしかない。\nそうしない: If we have decided to make peace, we must push it forward, by force if necessary. Otherwise, those sparks will only multiply without end.
m920201.嘘に嘘を積み重ねた結果にゃ。\nでも、まだ負けてはいにゃい。\n連中を倒してしま:
This is the result of piling lie upon lie.
But we haven't lost yet.
If we defeat them, no one will know the truth.
m920201.報告ご苦労にゃ。\n陣形はこのまま、太陽神殿を死守するにゃ。:
Good work on the report, my cat.
Hold your formation and defend the Sun Temple to the death, my cat.
m920201.太陽神様は、己が命と引き換えに、\n物質界の砂漠に太陽を取り戻したのにゃ。\nだ: The Sun God sacrificed his own life to restore the sun to the deserts of the material world, nya. That is why he no longer exists in this world, nya.
m920201.太陽神殿があるというなら、肝心の太陽神は？: If there's a Sun Temple, where is the Sun God himself?
m920201.契約の代償であった黄金も、\nもはや十分な量が供出されている。\nここから先は、:
The gold, which was the price of the contract, has already been paid in sufficient quantity.
From here on, it is up to them to decide their own fate.
m920201.女神アイギス、女神アダマスの神器、\n亜神トラムの輝きの剣、太陽神イルドナの応報:
The divine artifacts of Goddess Aigis and Goddess Adamas,
the Radiant Sword of Demi-God Tram, the Sword of Retribution of Sun God Ildana...
And from the All-Father of Asgard――
m920201.女神アイギスに永遠の命を貰ったからな、\nそう簡単に、性格まで変わりはしないさ。:
Since Goddess Aigis granted me eternal life,
my personality isn't exactly going to change overnight.
m920201.安寧の世界を望むと告げ、余に恭順を誓いながらも、\n彼らの魂には繁栄と生を望む意:
They told me they desired a peaceful world and swore their allegiance to me,
yet deep within their souls, they harbored a desire for prosperity and life.
m920201.容易に想像がつきますよ。\nかつては神の庇護下にあり、今は亜神ディアスの庇護下。:
It's easy to imagine why.
They were once under the protection of a god, and now they're under the Demigod Dias.
Their individual strength is considerable, but they lack real combat experience.
m920201.寝起きで運動とか、身体に悪いですよ？: Exercise right after waking up? That's bad for your body, you know.
m920201.待って、あの祭壇にあるのは……。\nまさかドラウプニルの腕輪！？:
Wait, what's on that altar is...
Could that be the Draupnir armlet?!
m920201.待つにゃ、あの腕輪は、\n戦乱の時代の砂漠を救った礼に、\nある獣人の女王から献: Hold on, nya, that armlet was a gift presented by a certain beastkin queen, in gratitude for saving the desert during the era of chaos, and――
m920201.怒る姿も可憐だな、アンブローズ。\nおぉよしよし、可愛いなぁ。:
Even when you're angry, you're adorable, Ambrose.
There, there. So cute.
m920201.悩んでも始まらにゃい、か。\nここを通すわけにはいかない、それにゃら、\nあいつ:
Worrying won't change anything, I suppose.
I can't let them pass, so I'll have to smash every last one of them, my cat.
m920201.悪だくみは終わったか？\nさぁ太陽と黄金に祝福されし民たちよ、\n不届き者どもを:
Are we done scheming?
Come, blessed people of the Sun and Gold!
Let us crush these insolent upstarts!
--- scene: Olympus Fourth Layer (battle, end) ---
m920201.惰弱な発想です……。\nアスガルドの民なら、\nきっとそんな壊死した世界は望みま:
What a lazy way of thinking…….
If the people of Asgard were here, they would surely never wish for such a rotting world.
m920201.憐れまないでくれますかぁ！？\nこれから成長しなおすんですからねぇ！:
Please don't look at me with that pitying expression!
I'm going to grow back to my proper size, you know!
m920201.懺悔をするにも、祈りを捧げるにも、\n本人がいるのなら本人の前ですればいいのです:
Whether you wish to confess your sins or offer your prayers,
it is best done in the presence of the one you address.
m920201.我らには太陽と黄金の加護がある！\nくくっ……連中を追い込むぞ！:
We have the protection of the Sun and Gold!
Heh... let's corner them!
m920201.我ら真なる太陽神の眷属と、\nその敬虔なる民の手で、\n貴様の大げさな伝説を終わ:
By the hands of us, the true kin of the Sun God,
and his devout people,
we shall put an end to your grandiose legend!
m920201.戦というものは、国同士、元首同士だけでなく、\n民の間まで、いくつもの火種と軋轢: War breeds not only conflict between nations and their leaders, but countless sparks of tension and friction among the people as well.
m920201.故郷ではないが、故郷に近い場所。\nなんとも不思議な感覚だな。:
It is not my homeland, but it is close to it.
What a strange sensation.
m920201.数で勝るからこそ、だ。\n連中の練度は高い。下手に追撃すれば、\n戦線が伸び切っ:
That is precisely why.
Their training is superior. If we pursue carelessly,
our lines will stretch too thin, and we'll be picked off one by one.
m920201.来るにゃら来ーい！！\nぶちのめしてやるにゃー！！:
Come at me then!!
I'll smash you to pieces, my cat!!
m920201.正確には設計者、くらいでしょうか。\nこの後に向かう第四層が砂漠の国の原型である: "Designer" would be more accurate, I suppose. Just as the Fourth Layer we're heading to is the prototype of the Desert Kingdom, Kunlun was the place that became the prototype of the Flower Kingdom.
m920201.民とて勝利に飢えているさ。\n何しろこいつは侵入者、永遠の安寧を約束された、\n:
The people are hungry for victory, too.
After all, this intruder has stepped into the Fourth Layer, "Nun,"
a land promised eternal peace, a plunderer!
m920201.民のために、同胞のために命まで燃やした。\n彼女は立派な戦士にして、王です。:
She burned her life for the people and her comrades.
She is a fine warrior, and a king.
m920201.民を守るために嘘をついていた。\nそれも、民も、神も、世界も騙す嘘を。\n太陽神:
They lied to protect the people.
Even a lie that deceived the people, the gods, and the world itself.
They concealed the very absence of the Sun God.
m920201.民を守る意志があり、そのために剣をとることができる。\n志を同じくする方々を処刑:
Those who have the will to protect their people and the ability to take up the sword for that cause……
There is no need to execute those who share the same ideals, is there?
m920201.永遠の安寧、変化のない世界、\n大きな幸福もない代わりに、\n誰も苦しまない場所: There are those who seek a place of eternal peace, a world without change. No great happiness, perhaps, but no suffering, either.
m920201.滅びを許容できぬなら、それは神ではない。\n矜持と生き様、それを守るためなら、\:
If one cannot accept destruction, one is not a god.
For the sake of their pride and the way they live,
they will choose to accept their own destruction.
m920201.無限の「黄金」を供出し続けることで、\nその庇護下に入っているんだ。: By offering up an endless supply of "gold," they have placed themselves under his protection.
m920201.物質界の砂漠は、太陽神様にとってみれば、\n我が子のような存在だ。愛し子が飢えて: To the Sun God, the deserts of the material world are like children. He could not have stood by and watched his beloved offspring starve.
m920201.特に、君らがヒュープの守る第一層を超えた直後から、\n太陽神殿の警備が過剰に強化:
Specifically, the moment you passed through the First Layer guarded by Huip,
the security around the Sun Temple was reinforced to an excessive degree.
m920201.王国は「ヌン」の民に対して、協力を惜しみません。\nヒュープ様、元始天尊様、ハリ:
The Kingdom will spare no effort in cooperating with the people of "Nun."
Hyp, Yuanshitian, and Haringheim have all agreed to support this initiative as well.
m920201.王子、聞いてのとおりです。\nあの亜神たちには\n不用意に兵を近付けさせないのが:
Prince, as you can see,
it would be wise not to bring our troops too close to those Demigods.
m920201.王子、黄金の魔力を消し飛ばす！\nあとはお前の指揮に任せたぞ。:
Prince, I'll obliterate the golden magic!
The rest is up to your command.
--- scene: The Radiance of Draupnir (battle, end) ---
m920201.王子ちゃん、このちんまい可愛い子は、\n一緒に千年戦争を戦った徐華ちゃんで――: Prince, this tiny, adorable girl is Xuhua. She fought alongside us in the Millennium War—
m920201.王子殿、兵士諸君、あの猫神像が見えるか？\nあれには可能な限り触れないように気を:
Your Highness, soldiers, can you see that statue of the cat deity?
Try not to touch it if you can help it.
If you accidentally attack it, things are going to get complicated.
m920201.王子殿は、お嬢さんたちを裁くつもりはないぞ。\nそうだろう？: Your Highness has no intention of judging you, girls. Correct?
m920201.生きるための知恵だと思ってあげよう。\n誰もが王子殿のように、\n自由意志こそ重: Let's call it the wisdom of survival. Not everyone thinks that free will is what matters most, the way Your Highness does.
m920201.目を離すとふらふら前線に出ていく最高司令官に、\n実力は確かだけどぽやぽやな司令:
I had to keep a close eye on the Supreme Commander, who would wander off to the front lines the moment I looked away,
and the competent but scatterbrained Commander,
and finally, this reliable but suffocating person. It was quite something.
m920201.砂漠の国の、バステト教団の者たちに会ってあげてください。\n長い歴史の波の中で教:
Please meet with the members of the Bastet Cult in the desert nation.
It is said that over the long waves of history, their doctrine became distorted and their traditions scattered――
m920201.砂漠の神は、この「ヌン」にいました。\n大いなる太陽神、戦神ゼクメト、\n豊穣の:
The gods of the desert were here, in this "Nun."
The Great Sun God, the War God Zekmet,
the Bountiful Bastet――no, Bastis... perhaps.
m920201.神々を殺しうる槍、グングニル。\n無限の富を生み出す腕輪、ドラウプニルが。:
Gungnir, the spear that can slay gods.
And Draupnir, the armlet that generates infinite wealth.
m920201.神なる右目、我が父の力を！\n今、我が身を捧げ――:
Divine Right Eye, the power of my father!
Now, I offer my body—
m920201.神殿を守ることだけが、目的ではない……？: Defending the temple isn't their only objective……?
m920201.私たちのッ！ 勝ちですッ！\nドラウプニルの腕輪を返しなさい！！:
We won!
Return the Draupnir armlet!!
m920201.私たちの信仰とは何だったのか、\n父祖の伝承が、子孫たる私たちに嘘を伝えていたの:
What was our faith, really?
Did the legends of our ancestors lie to us, their descendants?
m920201.私は、赦すつもりはありませんが。: I have no intention of forgiving, however.
m920201.私はこれまで、イルドナと協力し、\n第四層から上層へと続く経路を探していた。\n:
Up until now, I have been working with Ildna
to find a path from the Fourth Layer to the upper levels.
However, progress has been… difficult.
m920201.空を覆い尽くす暗黒の霧は、\nあたしたちの主神、偉大なる太陽神の力を弱め、\n民:
The dark mist that covered the sky
weakened the power of our lord, the great sun god,
and stole the will to live and the daily sustenance of the people, nya……
m920201.第四層「ヌン」の民への食料支援に、\n雇用確保に、訓練環境の提供じゃと？: Food aid for the people of the Fourth Layer, "Nun"…… securing employment, and providing a training environment, is it?
m920201.第四層「ヌン」は偉大なる太陽神に導かれし、\n繁栄と光の都だと聞いていましたが…:
I heard that the Fourth Layer, "Nun," is a city of prosperity and light,
guided by the great sun god……
Where is that sun god now?
m920201.管理者の元始天尊が好き勝手しておるのだ、\n儂が付いていったって良いじゃろ？:
The administrator, Yuanshi Tianzun, is doing whatever he pleases, you know.
I can come along without any trouble, can't I?
m920201.聞け王子、ドラウプニルの契約を半分奪った。\nこれから黄金の魔力を打ち消していく:
Listen, Prince. I've seized half of the Draupnir contract.
From here, I'll nullify the golden magic.
m920201.華の国の大地が、第二層「崑崙」をモデルとしたように、\n砂漠の国の大地は第四層「:
Just as the land of the Flower Country was modeled on the Second Layer, "Kunlun,"
the land of the Desert Country has been heavily influenced by the Fourth Layer, "Nun."
m920201.見逃すものか。\nこの第四層にいる限り、\nすべての民の目が、我らの目だ。:
Let them go?
As long as we remain in this Fourth Layer,
the eyes of every citizen are our eyes.
m920201.覚悟を決めた顔した小娘の、\n足を引っ張るとか、儂の趣味じゃないからのう！:
Tripping up a young lady who has made up her mind...
That's not really my style, you see!
--- scene: Faith in the Cat God ---
m920201.調子に乗るとぎっくり腰やりますよ？: If you push yourself too hard, you'll pull a muscle.
m920201.諦めるな。\n我が父は命を燃やし、太陽を取り戻した。\n民のために、砂漠のために:
Do not give up.
My father burned his life to reclaim the sun.
For the sake of the people, for the sake of the desert, we must not yield.
m920201.謝るなんて、あなたらしくないですよ。\nでも、ありがとうございます。:
Apologizing is not like you at all.
But... thank you.
m920201.負け猫根性が染み付いているのか、お前は。\n見苦しい……まるで命乞いのような語り:
Has the spine of a defeated cat seeped into you, you fool?
Disgusting…… your words sounded nothing like a plea for mercy……
m920201.足場を作ってやる。\nこいつを、略奪者を殺せッ！！:
I'll give you a foothold.
Kill this one, the plunderer!!
m920201.蹴散らしてやりましょう。\n今はなんだか、暴れたい気分です。\n私は後方の敵をい:
Let's trample them.
I feel like causing some trouble right now.
I'll take the enemies in the rear.
m920201.連中、民に嘘をついてるからなァ。\n死ぬ気で太陽神殿を防衛するんだろうな。:
They're lying to their people, you know.
They're going to defend the Sun Temple with their lives.
m920201.階層移動直後に遭遇したのは不運だったけど、\nそうでなくても、間違いなく敵対され:
It was bad luck that we ran into them right after the layer transition,
but even if we hadn't, we would have been treated as enemies
and ended up in the same situation.
m920201.隠れたがっているのに、それを教えるとか無粋じゃろ。\nそれに……。:
When someone is trying to hide, telling them that would be rather rude, wouldn't it?
Besides...
m920201.黄金は……もうないけど、\n捧げられるものはすべて、王国に捧げるにゃ。: The gold is……gone, but we will offer everything we have left to the Kingdom, nya.
m920201.（いつまで、偽りの神話を、\nこの階層は続けていけるのかにゃ……）:
(How much longer can this layer sustain
such a false myth...?)
--- scene: City of Hot Sand (battle, start) ---
m920201.（偽物だって、作りものだって、\nぜーんぶ守りとおして、幸せがっぽがっぽにゃ）:
(Even if it's fake, even if it's an illusion,
I'll protect it all and scoop up all that happiness, my cat.)

m920236.――あっ、マータンさんが戻ってきました。\nでも、何だか落ち込んでいるような……:
――Ah, Martan is back.
But he seems a bit dejected…
m920236.――うぅん、一歩進んだと思うよ。: ――Hmm, I think we've made progress, actually.
m920236.――うおぉぉぉぉぉッ！！\nよく来た挑戦者よ！ 白き獣の戦士よ！！:
—Ooooooh!!
Welcome, challenger! Warrior of the White Beast!!
m920236.――えーっと……。\n一箇所だけのつもりだったのに、\nあちこち回ってもらって…:
――Um…
I only meant to visit one place,
but you took me all over the place… um…
m920236.――おつかれさまでーす。\n物資補給でーす。\nあっ、今日の受付担当はフラフィー:
――Thanks for your hard work.
This is your supply resupply.
Ah, so Fluffy's the one on reception duty today.
m920236.――さて、というわけで、\n王国の里と、北の大国の里、\n雪枝の里の、友誼の儀式:
――Well, with that,
the friendship ceremony between the kingdom's village,
the great northern nation's village,
and the Snowbranch village is complete.
m920236.――ただし、ついてこられる者だけだ！\nさぁ行くぞ！ マータンダッシュ！！:
――But only those who can keep up!
Let's go! Martan Dash!!
m920236.――というわけで、詳しく教えていただけますか？: ――So, could you tell us everything in detail?
m920236.――み、みんな！ 話を聞いて！\nこの人たちは悪い人じゃないから！:
――Everyone! Please listen!
These people aren't the bad guys!
m920236.――もうひとつ朗報です。\nここに里が築かれた理由が分かりましたよ。:
――I have another piece of good news.
We've figured out why this village was built here.
m920236.――グオァァァァァッグ！！\n野郎ども、牙を剥け、咆哮を上げろ！！:
Beastman Knight?: ――GRRRAAAAGH!!
You scum, bare your fangs and roar!!
m920236.――フラフィーさん！ ポワワさん！\n急いで安全なところに隠れてください！！:
Northern Great Nation Knight: ――Fluffy! Powawa!
Get to safety, quickly!!
m920236.――何とも美味だった……。\n場所が違えば食が変わるものだが、\n北限……いや、:
――How delicious…
The food changes depending on where you are, but
the northernmost lands… no, the Interstice Snowfield is full of fine cuisine too.
m920236.――王子！ 侵入者です！\n敵は所属不明の獣人複数！\n警備兵を打ち倒した手練れ:
――Prince! We have intruders!
They're a group of unidentified beastfolk!
They're skilled fighters who've taken down our guards!
m920236.……あたしはまだまだ、半人前だよ。\nでも、なんだか、ちょっと良いなって思ったか:
……I'm still a long way from being a full-fledged guardian.
But, I guess I did feel a little good about it.
m920236.……いえ、こちらの\n行軍速度を上げる方が良いかもしれません。: ……No, I think it would be better if we increased our marching speed.
m920236.……うー。\nたまになら、ね。たまになら！:
……Ugh.
Once in a while, maybe. Just once in a while!
m920236.……えーっと、魔物ではない、と？: Northern Great Nation Knight: ……So, you're not a monster, huh?
m920236.……そうだ！\nねぇ、あんたたち、狭間の雪原を調べてるんでしょ？:
……That's it!
Hey, you guys are investigating the Snowfield Between, right?

You don't seem to be from the same village…
Anyway, come over here! You're going to get kidnapped!
m920236.むっ……むー。それは考えておく。\nさすがに勢いで答えるのは難しい。:
Mm… hmm. I'll think about it.
I can't just answer on a whim.
m920236.もう少しで雪枝の里に到着する。\nまずはマータンが、長老たちに報告するから、\n:
We'll be arriving at Yukieda Village soon.
I'll go report to the elders first, so you guys just wait at the entrance!
m920236.やけに殺気立ってるな……。\nどうやら、僕らのことを\n本気で敵だと認識している:
They're acting pretty hostile…
It looks like they've decided we're
enemies for real.
m920236.やっぱり……人さらいだと思われてるんでしょうか。: So… they really do think we're kidnappers.
m920236.やばいやつじゃん……！\n王子急いで急いで！:
This is bad…!
Prince, hurry, hurry!
m920236.やーられたー！\nっていうかやっぱ強いな！\nもうひと勝負したいくらいだ！:
Yee-haw!
I knew it! You guys are strong!
I'm itching for another round!
m920236.ようやく魔力嵐を抜けたか……。: We've finally broken through the mana storm…
m920236.よし、本日の主役の到着でーす！\n王国在住、酒場の花！\nぽわぽわ系吟遊詩人、プ:
And now, the star of the show has arrived!
Residing in the Kingdom, the flower of the tavern!
The fluffy bard, Prucia!
m920236.よーし、じゃあ行くぞー！\nマータン様のご帰還だー！:
Alright, let's go!
Welcome home, Martan-sama!
m920236.わ、分かった！\nマータンも、みんなも、無理はしないで！:
Y-yes, I understand!
Martan, and everyone, don't push yourselves too hard!
m920236.わ、私も、説得してみます。\nたぶん……あの子が心配してるのは、\nファオルさん:
I-I'll try to talk to them too.
I think… the reason that child is so worried is
because Faul is a white beastfolk…
m920236.わぁ……。\n何にも分かりません、\nって報告をまとめるのも大変ですね……。:
Oh my……
It must be tough putting together reports
that say we've learned absolutely nothing……
m920236.わっ、ポワワさん！\n物資輸送お疲れさまですー。:
Wha, Powawa!
Thanks for handling the supply transport.
m920236.わっ、雪国の人？\nそっか、ちょっと似てる匂いするなって思ってたんだ。:
Wha, you're from a snowy land?
I see, that's why I thought you smelled a bit familiar.
m920236.わはははー！\nついてきてるかー！？:
Wahahaha!
Can you keep up with me?!
m920236.ん、何だこの感じ……。\nおい、ユリクセス離れろ！！:
Hm? What's this feeling…
Ulyxes, get back!!
m920236.オークさんたちと修行するのがですか？: So you want to train with the Orcs?
m920236.グハァァッ……。\n獣人でもねぇ、ただの人間が……何だ、その力は……。:
Ghaah…
Not even a beastman, just a human… what is that power…
m920236.シビラ殿下、すでに包囲されています。: Your Highness Sybilla, we've already been surrounded.
m920236.ドーンブリンガーだっけ？\n空を飛べるなんて思いもしなかったし、\nあんなに速い:
The Dragonbringer, was it?
I never imagined it could fly,
and I was shocked by how fast it was.
m920236.ドーンブリンガーの観測した範囲では、\nまだ規模の小さな嵐のようではありますが…: Based on the Dawnbringer's observations, it appears to be a relatively small storm for now…
m920236.ファオルさんの里の方、でしょうか。: Could they be from Faul's village?
m920236.ファオルは戻ってこい、南の者は帰れ、\nここより北に進むのは止めておけ、とのこと: They said Faul must return, the Southerners must leave, and we should stop trying to advance any further north.
m920236.ボッコボコのギッタギタの！\nぐちゃどろばこーんにしてやるー！！:
I'll beat you to a pulp!
I'll make you into a bloody mess!
m920236.マータン、こういう悪知恵はたらくタイプ。\n戦士には筋肉だけじゃなくて知恵も必要:
I'm the type who comes up with schemes like this.
Warriors need brains, not just muscles.
m920236.マータン、この付近にも里はある？\nそれか、大きな獣の群生地があるとか……。:
Martan, is there another village nearby?
Or maybe a habitat for large beasts…?
m920236.マータン、もう一度長老たちを説得する。\n今度は期待して待ってて――:
I'll try to persuade the elders once more.
This time, I expect you to wait with hope—
m920236.マータン、狭間の雪原の取り決めが\nどうなっているかは知らないが、\nこいつらの:
Martan, I don't know the current state of the accord regarding the Snowfields,
but may we decide how to deal with these two?
m920236.マータンが力で押しすぎなんだってば。\nさっ、みんな里の中へどうぞ。\n歓迎の宴:
It's because Martan pushes too hard with brute force.
Come on, everyone, let's head inside.
They're planning a welcome feast for us♪
m920236.マータンは子犬ではない！\n誇り高き白熊の獣人だ！:
Martan is not a puppy!
I am a proud white bear beastman!
m920236.マータンは白熊の獣人族だから……。\nなんていうのか、勢いがすごいよね。:
Martan is a bear-kin, after all…
I don't know how to put it, but he's got a lot of momentum.
m920236.マータンひとりに任せて、大丈夫……？: Leave it to Martan alone… is that okay?
m920236.マータン！ こちらも加勢する！\n負傷者は下げて構わない！:
Martan! We'll join you!
Don't worry about the wounded!
m920236.マータン！ 話を聞いて！\nあたしは、外の世界に出たいの！\nこの人たちは悪い人:
Martan! Please listen!
I want to see the outside world!
These people aren't bad, and――
m920236.上空のドーンブリンガーが、\n魔力嵐の勢力増大を確認しました。\nもう少しで、こ:
The Dawnbringer in the sky has confirmed that the mana storm is intensifying.
It will hit this area directly in just a moment!
m920236.交流を望まない集落に、\nさぁ門戸を開け、とは言いたくないですからね。: I wouldn't want to demand that a village which seeks no contact open its gates to us.
m920236.人型の魔物と狼が街に侵入しました！\nかなり素早い個体で――:
Northern Great Nation Knight: Humanoid monsters and a wolf have broken into the town!
They're extremely fast individuals――
m920236.何が蛮族か！\nお前たちの方がよっぽど蛮族だ！:
Savage?
You're the ones who are savages!
m920236.信じられるかー！\nっていうかー！ 別に白くない子もさらわれるぞ！\n里の外は危:
Can you believe that!?
Besides, they don't just go after the white ones!
The village elder said the outside is dangerous!
m920236.俺たちはようやく手に入れた。\n永久の吹雪にも、南の蛮族にも負けない力だ。:
We have finally obtained it.
A power that fears neither the eternal blizzard nor the southern savages.
m920236.凍ってない森が見たかったの。\nすごい、本当に緑ばかり！:
I wanted to see a jungle that isn't frozen.
Wow, it's really all green!
m920236.前線への補給経路になりますし、\n雪枝の里の皆さんが望むなら、\n交易も可能にな:
It will serve as a supply route to the front lines,
and if the residents of Snowbranch Village wish it,
we might even be able to establish trade.
m920236.北は怪物！ 南は悪党！\nそれが里の教えでしょ！！:
The north is full of monsters! The south is full of scoundrels!
That's what the village taught us!
m920236.南の蛮族の手を借りたのか、\n雪枝の子犬ちゃんたちよォ。:
So you borrowed the help of the southern savages,
you little pups of the Snowbranch.
m920236.単純に、この辺りに慣れているのも要因かと。\n我々にとっては未知の世界ですからね:
Simply put, he's used to this terrain.
For the rest of us, it's a whole new world.
m920236.可愛い女の子と、その相棒の白狼ですね。: Just a cute girl and her white wolf companion.
m920236.向こうからすれば、言い足りないぐらいだろうね。: From their perspective, I'd say it's an understatement.
m920236.商店が襲撃を受けたというのは……。: Northern Great Nation Knight: And the raid on the shop……
m920236.大丈夫です。言葉が通じることは\nファオルさんと話して分かりましたし、\nきっと:
It's fine. Talking to Faul showed me that we can communicate,
so we should be able to have a dialogue with the pursuers, too.
m920236.大人は皆殺しにしろ！\nガキは全員連れていけ！！:
Kill all the adults!
Take all the children with you!!
m920236.対話を諦めないのはいいことだ。\nマータン、そういうの好きだ。:
Not giving up on dialogue is a good thing.
Martan likes that kind of thing.
m920236.将来は村の守護者か！\nうむ、うむ！ 実に良い！\n是非とも手合わせを願いたい！:
You'll be the village's protector in the future!
Yes, yes! Excellent!
I must have a match with you!!
m920236.少しでも情報が得られると――: If we can get even a shred of information—
m920236.徒歩での旅も悪くないぞ。\n雪がないだけであれだけ大騒ぎしたんだ。\n自分の足で:
Traveling on foot isn't bad, either.
She made such a fuss over nothing but snow.
I'm curious to see how she reacts when she has to walk it all herself.
m920236.御冗談を。\nあなたを差し置いて飛び入り参加など。:
Please.
Jumping in and upstaging you?
m920236.恩に着る！\nファオル、長老たちに伝令を頼む！:
I appreciate it!
Faul, send word to the elders!
m920236.悪党どもー！ ファオルを返さないなら……。: You scoundrels! If you don't hand Faul back…
m920236.我らも負けてはいられぬ。\nファオルと言ったか？\n打倒王子を掲げ、共に修行を―:
We cannot afford to be outdone.
Was it Faul, you said?
Let us train together, with the goal of defeating the Prince—
m920236.戦士たちよ、剣をとれ！\n賊をギッタギタのバッキバキにするぞ！:
Warriors, take up your swords!
We'll smash these bandits to pieces!
m920236.戦闘を避けて下がるにも限界がある。\nこれより先は市街地だぞ。:
We can't keep retreating to avoid a fight.
We're entering the town from here.
m920236.手始めに貴様らを全員肉塊にしてやる。\n死にてぇ奴から出てきやがれ！\nグオァァ:
As a warm-up, I'll turn every one of you into a pile of meat.
Come out, whoever wants to die!
Guaaaah!!
m920236.旅……自分の足で……。: Travel… on my own two feet…
m920236.物質界の多くの国が名乗る雅称は、\n英雄王にちなんで名付けられたものですからね。:
Many nations in the Material World take their names from the Hero King.
As a result, they tend to be defined by their direction relative to the kingdom.
m920236.狭間の雪原から見れば、\n私たちの知る国々の全てが、\n南の国、みたいになるのか: From the perspective of the Barren Snowfields, perhaps all the nations we know of are considered “southern countries.”
m920236.狭間の雪原の道案内も、\nあたしとマータンで引き受けることになったよ。:
Faul and Martan will be your guides
through the Interstice Snowfield.
m920236.獣人戦士の軍勢……？\nこの規模、野盗の類ではなさそうね。:
An army of beastmen warriors…?
At this scale, they don't seem like mere bandits.
m920236.王国にも、まだまだいい音楽家がいる。\nさぁ、聴かせてもらおうかな。:
The Kingdom still has plenty of fine musicians.
Come, let's hear her play.
m920236.王子、あの獣人たちから\n嫌な魔力の匂いがするわ。\nただの賊だって油断しちゃだ:
Prince, I can sense an unpleasant mana
emanating from those beastmen.
Don't let your guard down, thinking they're just bandits!
m920236.王子、あの獣人の魔力が膨れ上がっていきます！\nこれは……間違いありません、\n:
Prince, that beastman's mana is surging!
This is… unmistakably,
a reaction to the Black Crown's power!!
m920236.王子よ、此度も実に良い戦いだった。\nあれからさらに腕を上げたな。:
Prince, this was a fine battle as well.
You have grown even stronger since last time.
m920236.王子様だって聴きに来てるんだから、\nもうほんといまさらですねー。:
The Prince is even here to listen,
so it's really too late to worry about that now!
m920236.畜生、負け猫にはかける言葉すらねぇってことかよ。: Tch… So you're just a beaten cat. Not even worth a parting shot.
m920236.白い毛並みの獣人同士、\n困ったときは助け合いということで！:
As fellow white-furred beastfolk,
we help each other out when we're in trouble!
m920236.皆さん、今日の主役たちと、音楽を守りますよ。\n戦闘――いえ、ダンスの準備を。:
Everyone, let's protect today's stars and the music.
Prepare for battle—no, for the dance.
m920236.目を見れば分かるさ。あいつら、\nファオルを見るときだけ心配そうな顔してやがる。:
You just have to look at their eyes.
The only time they look worried
is when they're staring at Faul.
m920236.確かに。\nここまで手がかりがひとつもなかったのです。\nここはファオルさんに頼:
Indeed.
We haven't had a single clue up until now.
Let's try relying on Faul.
m920236.確かに悪い人はいますし、\n白い獣人が狙われているのも事実ですが――: I know there are bad people out there, and that white beastfolk are being targeted, but――
m920236.私たちは、北限の――いえ、\n「狭間の雪原」を超えたいの。:
We wish to cross the... no,
the "Snowfields of the In-Between."
m920236.総員戦闘準備！\n移動しつつ魔物を撃退するぞ！:
All units, prepare for battle!
We'll repel the monsters while moving!
m920236.聞き分けの悪い犬は嫌いだ。\n犬は犬らしく、強者にひれ伏しなァ！！:
I despise disobedient dogs.
A dog should act like a dog and grovel before its masters!!
m920236.脱走者を追ってきたって感じじゃねぇ。\nこれは、末っ子がさらわれた、\nとでも思:
This isn't just a chase for runaways.
They probably think
our youngest sister has been kidnapped.
m920236.補給拠点は置けなくとも、ファオルの旅立ちと、\n私たちが里の近くを通過することを: Even if we can't set up a supply base, getting them to acknowledge Faul's departure and allow us to pass near the village would be more than enough of a success.
m920236.遥か昔には繁栄した街があったそうですから、\nその末裔たちなのかもしれません。:
It is said that a prosperous city once thrived there in ancient times,
so they may be descendants of its people.
m920236.里の子たちを守ってくれた、\n命の恩人たちのためならって、できることは\n全部し:
They said that if it was for the people
who saved the lives of the village children,
we should do everything we could for them.
m920236.里長が不在だったのもあるしな。\n王子たちがいなかったら、\n本当に里が壊滅して:
The village chief wasn't here, either.
If it hadn't been for you all,
the village might have been completely destroyed.
m920236.長老たちがね、里を守ってくれたお礼がしたいって。\nそれからここに、活動拠点を作:
The elders want to thank us for protecting the village.
They've also granted us permission to set up a base here,
and for me and Martan to guide you through the Snowfields.
m920236.長老たちも石頭だけど、わからず屋じゃないからね。\nというのも、あの賊たちが、\:
The elders can be stubborn, but they're not unreasonable.
It seems those bandits
were the cause of the recent abductions.
m920236.雪をかき分けるような音……。\nこれはソリじゃなくて、\n大勢が走ってくる音ね？:
The sound of snow being churned up…
This isn't a sled.
It sounds like a large group is running toward us?
m920236.雪枝の里、というのは？: The village of Yukieda? What is that?
m920236.音だけで聴かせるあの技術……。\nまだ若いのに大したもんだ。:
The skill of captivating an audience with just sound...
Impressive for someone so young.
m920236.駐屯地の皆さん、騒ぎを鎮めるの、手伝ってくださいー！: Everyone at the garrison, please help us put a stop to this commotion!
m920236.驚いたわ……。\n北限に……いえ、ファオルの言葉を借りるなら、\n「狭間の雪原」:
I'm surprised…….
In the northernmost region……no, to borrow Faul's words, survivors were living in the "Snowfield Between."
m920236.魔力嵐って、狭間の雪原の空をずーっと覆ってる、\n魔力の乱流でしょ？\n空の上の:
The mana storm is that constant turbulence of magic energy covering the sky over the snowfields in the In-Between, right?
Isn't it something we don't need to worry about since it's up in the air?
m920236.（……緊張してる場面で、\nそういう事言わないでよ！ もう！）: (…Stop saying things like that when I'm already nervous! Ugh!)
m920236.（あ、事情を聞き出せたみたいよ？）: (Ah, looks like she got the story out of her?)
m920236.（あれで通じるの、親友同士って感じするね）: (I can tell they're best friends from how that went.)
m920236.（友だちだからって分かるものじゃなくない？）: (Just because they're friends doesn't mean you can understand everything, though?)
m920236.（私、クラリーチェの考えてること、\nちょっと分かるよ……？）: (I think I get what Clarice is thinking a little…?)
m920236.（雪女って、こうやって旅人を惑わすんだなぁ。\nふゆのさん、味方でよかったぁ……:
(So that's how snow women lure travelers in.
Glad Fuyuno's on our side……)
